question: Should OpenClaw accept the new `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` option plus always-on auth/profile/secrets hot-mode restart carve-out and RPC parity as the permanent hot-mode contract?
rationale: The branch changes a compatibility-sensitive config/default surface, credential/provider restart behavior, and hot-mode RPC semantics; those are product and operator-policy choices automation should not make alone.

options.title: Approve split contract after proof
options.body: Require the docs fixes and final-head real behavior proof, then land the opt-in routine restart behavior plus always-on security-critical restart carve-out.

options.title: Keep hot mode warn-and-keep
options.body: Reject the new config option/default carve-out and rely on diagnostics or explicit writer restart intent for operators who need recovery.

options.title: Narrow to explicit writer intent
options.body: Drop broad automatic restart policy and make doctor/config writers declare restart-required intent for known repair batches only.

recommendation.title: Approve split contract after proof
recommendation.body: Require the docs fixes and final-head real behavior proof, then land the opt-in routine restart behavior plus always-on security-critical restart carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/config-surface history makes this the best available individual routing candidate for the hot-mode product contract.
